Package net.boricj.bft.ctf

Class CTFType

java.lang.Object
net.boricj.bft.ctf.CTFType
public class CTFType extends Object
Represents a single CTF type record. Each type has a kind (leaf type identifier) and a size/alignment information.

  • Method Details

    • parse

      public static CTFType parse(ByteInputStream stream, int typeId, CTFStringSection strings) throws IOException, CTFException
      Parses one type record from the type-section stream.
      Parameters:
      stream - type-section stream positioned at the next record
      typeId - sequential CTF type identifier to assign
      strings - dictionary string section
      Returns:
      parsed type record, or null if not enough bytes remain for a full header
      Throws:
      IOException - if data cannot be read
      CTFException - if the type record is structurally invalid
